title: clematis × lawsoniana var. henryi
intro: Clematis × lawsoniana var. henryi, commonly known as the Henry's clematis, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Clematis genus. It is known for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, which may help alleviate conditions such as arthritis and wounds. The plant's therapeutic actions include promoting wound healing, reducing pain, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties, making it a potential remedy for skin and soft tissue infections. The bioactive constituents of Henry's clematis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
